statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail 24 reflects fresh Hormuz escalation while NQ is closed and live path evidence remains unavailable.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The Sunday Globex reopening is the next direct price-path checkpoint; elevated Tail remains conditional on persistent one-way follow-through.
headline: Fresh Hormuz vessel claim keeps closed-market Nasdaq Tail at WATCH 24
body: NQ is closed. Associated Press reports Iran's claim that it struck an unmanned U.S. vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, which the U.S. had not immediately confirmed. Saturday's U.S.-Iran vessel exchange and Friday's yield repricing keep Stress extreme. Shared Finviz context from 06:32 UTC is stale beyond 90 minutes.

lookbackSummary: 11:00 UTC Saturday-10:00 UTC Sunday: Tail held 24 through 01:00, eased to 23 at 02:00-03:00 and 22 at 04:00-06:00, dipped to 21 at 07:00, then returned to 24 from 08:00 as fresh Hormuz escalation was reported.
outlookSummary: Tail stays below the current block threshold while NQ is closed. Conditional Tail peaks at 34 at the 22:00 UTC Sunday Globex reopening only if a directional gap is followed by shallow or failed retracements and reinforcing cross-asset pressure.
